name: sky-cua
description: Codex adapter for the configurable cross-platform sky-cua MCP control runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable Sky CUA runtime payload for Codex
interface.longDescription: Sky CUA is the payload plugin behind the Computer Use compat plugin. It ships one configurable MCP control runtime whose desktop, browser, and phone surfaces are projected by machine policy, together with structured diagnostics. The Computer Use plugin id stays the single enabled entry point; this plugin carries the runtime it points at.
defaultPrompt: Check which Sky CUA capabilities are available
Inspect the currently enabled Sky CUA surfaces
